meta_description:
1,548 likes, 106 comments - drmarkhyman on October 28, 2026: "How many times have you talked yourself out of something you know is good for you in the few seconds before you act?

Bestselling author and podcast host @melrobbins explains how she created the 5 Second Rule at 41, when she was deep in debt, out of work, and struggling to get out of bed each morning. 

The moment you start counting backward from five, you’ve already decided to do the hard thing. That small, intentional action quiets the noise of your feelings and points your attention at the next step.

Tune into our full conversation to learn:

Why waiting to feel motivated keeps you stuck
How to set up your environment so the healthy choice is the easy one
The ABC method for influencing someone you love without pushing them
So much more…

Your feelings will always show up first, and learning to act anyway is where real change in your health begins.

🎧 Episode is out now. Drop a YES below and I’ll DM you the link to listen!".
